name: io.github.UnicornGraveyard/slicerbridge
title: SlicerBridge
description: A Rosetta Stone for multicolor 3MF files: one project in, a checked file for every printer out.

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_ORCASLICER
environmentVariables.description: Where OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, which writes the files for Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic, Flashforge and QIDI printers is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_BAMBU_STUDIO
environmentVariables.description: Where Bambu Studio, which writes the files for Bambu Lab printers is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_PRUSASLICER
environmentVariables.description: Where PrusaSlicer, which builds the Prusa printer profiles is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_SNAPMAKER_ORCA
environmentVariables.description: Where Snapmaker Orca, which slices the Snapmaker U1 file is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_CREALITY_PRINT
environmentVariables.description: Where Creality Print, for brand-check only is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_ELEGOOSLICER
environmentVariables.description: Where ElegooSlicer, for brand-check only is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_ANYCUBIC_SLICER_NEXT
environmentVariables.description: Where Anycubic Slicer Next, for brand-check only is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_FLASH_STUDIO
environmentVariables.description: Where Flash Studio (Orca-Flashforge), for brand-check only is installed (default: /Applications)

environmentVariables.name: SLICERBRIDGE_QIDI_STUDIO
environmentVariables.description: Where QIDI Studio, for brand-check only is installed (default: /Applications)
